core_values: Regulated market economy with social safety nets

economic_policy.taxation: Progressive income tax with higher brackets for top earners; capital gains taxed as ordinary income; targeted tax credits for low- and middle-income families.
economic_policy.trade: Support multilateral free-trade agreements with labour and environmental standards; oppose unilateral tariffs.
economic_policy.regulation: Moderate regulation to ensure consumer protection, financial stability, and fair competition; streamline permitting for small businesses.

social_policy.healthcare: Universal healthcare coverage through a public option alongside private insurance; cap prescription drug prices.
social_policy.education: Increase public school funding; universal pre-K; subsidised post-secondary tuition; student loan reform.
social_policy.housing: Expand affordable housing supply through zoning reform and public-private partnerships; strengthen tenant protections.
social_policy.civil_rights: Comprehensive anti-discrimination protections; marriage equality; reproductive rights; voting rights expansion.
social_policy.immigration: Pathway to citizenship for long-term residents; streamlined legal immigration; humane border enforcement; refugee resettlement commitments.

governance.decentralization: Strong federal standards with local implementation flexibility; empower municipal governments on housing and transit.
governance.transparency: Mandatory public disclosure of government contracts and lobbying; strengthen freedom-of-information laws.
governance.electoral_reform: Independent redistricting commissions; ranked-choice voting; automatic voter registration; campaign finance limits.

environment.climate_action: Net-zero emissions target by 2050; carbon pricing mechanism; rejoin and strengthen international climate agreements.
environment.energy: Accelerate renewable energy deployment; phase out coal; transition support for fossil-fuel-dependent communities.
environment.conservation: Expand protected lands and marine areas; strengthen endangered species protections; fund urban green spaces.

security.defense: Maintain strong defence capability; prioritise diplomacy and alliance-based security; reform military procurement.
security.law_enforcement: Community policing models; police accountability and oversight boards; invest in mental-health crisis response teams.
security.foreign_policy: Multilateral engagement through international institutions; promote democracy and human rights abroad; strategic foreign aid.
